B, the union of row/column simplices, has nerve K_m,n; each rectangle attaches relative to its 4-cycle. This yields a degree-2 relative free group wedge^2(Z^m) tensor wedge^2(Z^n), with connecting map phi onto H1(B)=W_m tensor W_n because 4-cycles generate all K_m,n cycles. Thus H2(Gamma)=ker(phi) free of stated rank, no other reduced homology. Integral equivariant Alexander duality shifts to degree mn-5 and twists by sign(sigma)^n sign(tau)^m; the displayed character follows the two virtual-lattice characters.
